title: When a conversation needs a summary

steps.path: A conversation after the assistant summarizes older messages
steps.headline: After a native summary, dim the older messages but not the recent messages kept alongside it.
steps.changed: Keep the summary marker already added by the in-session work. The proposed change dims only the older summarized portion; the retained recent messages stay at normal contrast. The full chat remains readable.
steps.notice: The marker shows where the summary happened without falsely fading recent messages that were carried forward.
steps.risk: The change applies to native automatic summaries; clearing the chat and Claude Code summaries retain their existing treatment. This image shows today's chat, not a completed summary.

steps.path: Choose a model with less room than this conversation needs
steps.headline: Ask before switching to a model that cannot fit this conversation.
steps.changed: The new dialog says: ‘This chat is too long for [new model]. [Current model] can summarize older messages first.’ One ‘Summarize and switch’ button, plus X or Esc to stay.
steps.notice: The current model summarizes first. The switch only happens if that summary fits the new model; fitting chats switch without a dialog.
steps.risk: Failure keeps the current model and shows an honest error. The picture is today's picker, not the unbuilt dialog.

steps.surface: Model picker on a narrow window
steps.path: Choose a smaller model while the app is phone-width
steps.headline: Keep the same summarize-or-dismiss choice usable at phone width.
steps.changed: The button and X stay visible at phone width. X or Esc preserves the chat and model. The picture is today's picker, not the unbuilt dialog.
steps.notice: One choice works at both widths. We will review the actual narrow dialog after implementation.
